districts.name: Marketplace
districts.blurb: Stalls, rare vendors, oddities and the odd caravan. Stock changes every stage.

districts.name: Trading Post
districts.blurb: Pokémon swaps, held-item exchanges and the notice board.

districts.name: Gathering Square
districts.blurb: Regulars, returning rivals, old foes and travellers. Rumours change hands here.

districts.name: Social Terrace
districts.blurb: The Battle Club, errands and friendly company.

districts.name: Back Alley
districts.blurb: A narrow passage behind the bins.

travelers.name: Wandering Birder
travelers.line: I come for the feathers. This plaza trades in everything.

travelers.name: Retired Gym Trainer
travelers.line: I led a gym once. Now I just watch the kids argue about types.

travelers.name: Ribbon Collector
travelers.line: Show me a Pokémon who loves you and I'll show you a ribbon.

travelers.name: Map Seller
travelers.line: Every route has a secret, friend. Some of them are even true.

travelers.name: Berry Farmer
travelers.line: Mulch makes the difference. Ask anybody.

travelers.name: Street Performer
travelers.line: Tip the Pokémon, not the trainer. The Pokémon work harder.

travelers.name: Ferry Pilot
travelers.line: I take the long way. Fewer trainers on the long way.

travelers.name: Old Fisher
travelers.line: Fish bite hardest the night before a big battle. Don't ask why.

travelers.name: Backpacker
travelers.line: Three regions in one bag. Mind the Pokéball in the pocket.

travelers.name: Tournament Scout
travelers.line: I'm watching for talent. Try not to trip.

chatter: Did you see that Pokémon's Speed?
Everyone saw. The whole square saw.
Prices are always up. Buy first, grumble later.
Heard a rumour about the next gym.
Heard it was exactly the opposite.
That stall's berries are the best.
Only because you haven't tried the other one.
My Pokémon refuses to leave the fountain.
The Battle Club was packed last night.
It's always packed. That's why I come early.

rare.name: Gilded Merchant
rare.line: Gold is just a colour I wear. The stock is what shines.

rare.name: Retired Champion
rare.line: I lost, once. It was the best thing that ever happened to me.

rare.name: Moon Pilgrim
rare.line: Come back at night. The plaza is a different place.

rare.name: The Gardener in Grey
rare.line: Some visitors never leave. Don't worry. They're polite.

bubbles.secretClosed: A narrow passage behind the bins. Nobody will let you in yet.
